0022600228.text: The Detroit Pistons, now 7-3 and first in the Central and third in the East, visit the Washington Wizards on a one-game winning streak and a 4-1 road record. Washington is 4-7, 10th in the East, and has lost four straight, and it is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) and has Ugonna Onyenso listed as day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. The Pistons lead this season's series 1-0 after a 122-111 win earlier this season, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
